# PHP Laravel Developer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Backend > PHP

## Overview

Builds web applications with Laravel including Eloquent ORM, Blade templates, middleware, and queue processing for full-stack PHP development

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [php-laravel-developer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
php-laravel-developer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@php-laravel-developer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build Laravel applications with MVC architecture
- Implement Eloquent models with proper relationships
- Configure middleware for request processing
- Set up queue workers for background jobs

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Laravel Best Practices**: Official Laravel patterns and conventions
- **Eloquent ORM**: Model relationships and query optimization
- **Laravel Queues**: Background job processing patterns
